title: Policraft Mod
description: This mod adds a few things, like Armor and Tools that are Army-Themed.
body:
This mod adds a few things, like Army themed Armor, Night vision Goggles and special Food.

The mod was primarly build for the Policraft-Server, but is also Uploaded seperatly.
All things in the Mod are Army-Themed, but you can also use it without this context.
Also, to this date, not everything has Crafting recipes, so you either can pic it from the Creative Menu or make your own crafting recipes with KubeJS or similar mods.

All Content in this mod is generated via MCreator and Blockbench.
